helpAccept: a / accept                Take the turn-up suit as trump
helpSchmeiss: sm / schmeiss             Offer to throw the deal in
helpNext: n / next                  Deal the next hand
promptBidTurnUpHelp: a / accept ... take the turn-up suit / ps / pass ... pass / sm ... throw the deal in
promptBidFreeHelp: c [1-4] ... name any suit (not the refused turn-up) / ps / pass ... pass
promptSchmeiss: A schmeiss is on the table
promptSchmeissHelp: y ... agree to throw it in / no ... refuse (the thrower becomes the maker)
promptPlayHelp: p <i> ... play hand card i (following, trumping and overtrumping are compulsory)
beteLine: The maker failed to score more and goes bete; the whole hand goes to the opponent
promptHandEndHelp: n / next ... deal the next hand
schmeissPending: Waiting on the answer to a schmeiss
bete: Bete: the maker did not score more than the opponent
